blind_target.title: Student and teacher outcomes of the class-wide function-related intervention team (CW-FIT) program
blind_target.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to provide a close conceptual replication of the first CW-FIT RCT ( Wills et al., 2016 ) by using methods of the original study and following procedures as closely as possible ( Cook, 2014 ;  Coyne et al., 2016 ).
blind_target.outcome_quote: Effects in this CW-FIT study provided a successful replication for student and teacher outcomes, indicating positive findings and significantly better performance for high-risk students in intervention classes than for those in the comparison classrooms ( Wills et al., 2016 ).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly give an overall successful replication verdict for student and teacher outcomes. Smaller Tier 2 effects and differences among sites do not override that verdict.
